meta.definition: b_l(D) = quantile_q[S(t) - min_{t<=t'<=t+D} S(t')] / mean S, over start slots t whose window lies inside the series; window D = tau + H of the contract
meta.ir_multiplier: 1 / (1 - b); null when b >= 1 (contract not offerable from this lender)
meta.n_disjoint: floor(n_slots / (D/5 + 1)): disjoint windows that fit in the series
meta.n_tail_episodes: groups of mutually overlapping windows with drop >= the quantile; null if the quantile is 0
meta.D_max_offerable_min: largest grid window D such that b(D') < 1 for every grid D' <= D; null if none. The true limit lies between it and the next grid window
meta.D_max_offerable_5min_min: largest window D on the 5-min grid up to 1440 min with b_envelope_5min(D) < 1; 1440 means at least 24 h; null if none
meta.b_envelope: max of b(D') over the grid windows D' <= D only (non-decreasing in D); ir_multiplier_envelope uses it
meta.b_envelope_5min: max of b(D') over every 5-min window D' <= D (a9_notice_buffer.buffer_curve); the pricing buffer b_l(D_k) of a11 (the MS1 simulator is to use the same function); _argmax_D_min is the window attaining it
meta.max_drop_frac: largest drop over all windows, as a fraction of mean slack
meta.median_p99_over_max_drop: median over the group of b_p99 / max_drop_frac; near 1 means the P99 is in effect the largest drop observed
